messages:
Priya Nair: Heads up — Sales asked for clarification on ratecard v2026 backfill rules. Customer 'MedScale' asked to apply Feb
mar usage retroactively to hit commit. Is this new policy stricter than v2025?
Ethan Brooks: Yes, v2026 removed automatic grandfathering. Backfill allowed only with signed amendment or explicit deal-desk credit. Need to confirm threshold.
Liam O'Connor: Are we changing the threshold from $25k to $50k? I thought that was the change.
Priya Nair: Correct 
mper product note: exceptions up to $50k ARR can be handled with a credit; above requires amendment + finance review. Link: https://redwood.internal/ratecard/v2026#backfill
Ethan Brooks: what's the approval SLA for amendments? Sales needs timeline to tell customers.
DealDesk Bot: New policy: amendment approvals target 3 business days for low complexity (<$50k) and 7-10 for >$50k. Ticketing required.
Legal - Anya: We need precise language for amendment. Use 'amendment effective date' not 'retroactive application'. Also confirm the accounting note so revenue ops can journal entries.
Finance Bot: Flag: any backfill that changes commit tier triggers COP review if uplift >10% of booked ARR. Provide incremental ARR in ticket.
Priya Nair: Can we patch the internal sales KB to include a one-page checklist? Eg: 1) estimate ARR impact 2) choose credit vs amendment 3) attach PO 4) submit DD ticket
Liam O'Connor: I'll draft the checklist. Also propose a short email template to request customer signature for amendment.
Ethan Brooks: For messaging to customers 
void 'retroactive' wording. Use 'amend effective date to MM/DD/YYYY' per legal.
Priya Nair: creating deal desk ticket now. @DealDesk Bot please open ticket and tag RevOps + Legal + Finance
DealDesk Bot: Ticket created DD-3488. Tags: RevOps, Legal, Finance. ETA note: Sales SLA 72h target. Link: https://redwood.internal/dealdesk/DD-3488
Liam O'Connor: attaching proposed email template in the ticket: ```
Subject: Amendment to include prior usage
Body: Hi {{CustomerName}}, we've attached an amendment to set the effective date to {{Date}} which will apply your prior usage to the annual commit. Please sign and upload the PO.
```
Priya Nair: Thanks. Also, heads-up to sales managers 
s ratecard v2026 rollouts next week, patch 2026.1 will add UI flag in billing to mark 'backfill applied' for audit.
Ethan Brooks: Great an billing ops confirm lead time to flip flag? @Billing-Ops
Finance Bot: Billing ops note: expect 5 business days to implement flag and 2 for one-off credit flow.
Priya Nair: OK closing 
next steps: Liam finalize checklist, Ethan own customer comms, Priya upload PO template + start DD-3488. Update this thread when PO uploaded.
DealDesk Bot: DD-3488 status -> awaiting attachments. Reminder set 48h.
Priya Nair: thanks all :thumbsup:
